content.rendered:
Sherwood School District Kinder registration packets will be available on Tuesday, Feb. 18th in all SSD elementary school offices. All Kinder Registration packets will be generic for Sherwood School District 2020 Kinder classes. The SSD School Board will be voting on the proposed 2020 school boundary on Wednesday, Feb. 12th. Check in at your nearby Sherwood elementary school on Feb. 18th or later for your child’s school location for 2020.  

Kinder Open house for 2020 Kinders will be on Wednesday, March 4th from 3:30 pm – 6:00 pm at each elementary school.  This is a drop in event.
